comment: Every one of the sixteen gate outputs is written by the same two lines (src/Pads.cpp:170-171), so one props entry covers them all. Where two channels carry the same note, the later channel is the one an expander follows (src/Pads.cpp:147). Latch toggles on the rising edge of the note match, not on the raw gate, so a latched cell does not retrigger while the note is held. The expander message carries the raw note match rather than the latched state, so a PadX on a velocity lane follows the physical note even where the gate output is latched on.
